About Us

A general trading company built on trust and quality.

Based in Maharashtra, India, Zenith Intercontinental bridges producers and buyers across borders. We source, verify, ship and distribute food products with a focus on freshness, documentation and dependable delivery.

Our mission is to make quality food trade simple, transparent and reliable for partners in India and abroad.

Our approach combines careful sourcing, clear communication and professional logistics support at every step.

Our Products

Import and export, in both directions.

We bring premium fresh and dry fruits into India, and take Indian staples and specialty products to markets around the world.
